errors.van_unknown: This van no longer exists. Refresh the page and pick another.
errors.route_unknown: This route no longer exists. Refresh the page and pick another.
errors.run_unknown: This run was not found. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.run_closed: This run is closed, so it cannot change. Open a new run on the device.
errors.customer_unknown: This customer cannot be used. Pick another customer.
errors.rep_unknown: This user cannot be the rep. Pick another user.
errors.location_unknown: This location cannot be used. Pick another location.
errors.load_not_open: This load sheet is no longer open. Refresh the page.
errors.load_not_released: This load sheet has not been released yet. Release it first.
errors.load_confirmed: This load sheet is already confirmed and cannot change.
errors.count_open: A count for this run is already waiting. Wait for its decision.
errors.count_not_pending: This count is not waiting for the warehouse. Refresh the page.
errors.unload_not_ready: The unload is not ready to receive. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.inventory_required: Inventory must be on to do this. Ask an administrator to subscribe to it.

vans.title: Vans
vans.description: The vans that sell on routes, with their rep, stock location and device.
vans.archiveAsk: Archive {{name}}? Its history stays; it can no longer start runs.
vans.empty: No vans yet. Add the first van to start selling on routes.
vans.locationHelp: Leave on new location to make a store location named like the van.
vans.deviceHelp: Pick an existing location first to choose a device paired there.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: The customer routes, the days they are visited and their default van.
routes.empty: No routes yet. Add a route, then list its stops.

stops.title: Stops
stops.help: Customers in the order they are visited. A stop without its own days follows the route.
stops.empty: No stops yet. Add a customer to start the list.

plan.title: Route plan
plan.description: The stops due on a day, in order, with the state of that day's run.
plan.empty: No stops are due on this day.

loads.title: Load-out
loads.description: Stock sent from a warehouse to a van before the day starts.
loads.cancelHelp: The sheet closes and the stock stays in the warehouse.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Each van's selling day: visits, sales, collections and the end-of-day count.
runs.noLoads: No load sheets for this run.
runs.noCount: The rep has not submitted a count yet.

reconciliations.title: Counts
reconciliations.description: The end-of-day counts of stock, cash and mobile money. Counts with a variance are decided in the approvals inbox.
reconciliations.pendingHelp: A supervisor approves or rejects this variance in the approvals inbox. The run closes when it is approved.
reconciliations.rejectedHelp: The rep recounts on the device. The new count appears as another attempt.
reconciliations.equation: Load = sold + returned + damaged + variance. A positive variance is a shortage, a negative one a surplus.
reconciliations.cashHelp: Expected is what the sales and collections should have brought in. Credit never counts as cash.

unload.cardHelp: The good stock goes back to the warehouse by a transfer, which the storekeeper receives.
unload.awaiting: Waiting for the transfer to be approved before it can be received.
unload.title: Receive unload
unload.help: Count what arrived at the warehouse. Differences become transit loss in Inventory.
unload.nothing: No stock came back on this count.

credit.accountsDescription: What each customer owes from route sales, against their credit limit.
credit.accountsEmpty: No customer owes anything from route sales.
credit.reviewsDescription: Credit sales that went over a limit or were decided without a connection. Reviewing changes no money.
credit.reviewHelp: Record that you looked at this sale. The balance does not change.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: Money collected from customers on the road, in cash or mobile money.
collections.voidHelp: Voiding {{receipt}} puts the amount back on the customer's balance.

reports.title: Van sales reports
reports.description: Sales, strike rate, collections, variances and credit outstanding for a period.
reports.empty: No visits or sales in this period.
reports.noInventory: Inventory is not on, so stock levels on the vans are not available.
reports.noVanStock: No stock is recorded on the vans.

positions.title: Check-in positions
positions.privacy: Positions are personal data of the rep and the customer. One point is kept per visit and cleared after the retention period. Do not copy them elsewhere.
positions.empty: No positions were recorded on this run.

settings.title: Van sales settings
settings.description: Location check-in and credit flags for a company.
settings.noCompany: Create a company first to set this up.
settings.gpsHelp: When optional, the rep is asked once, in the app, to share the phone's position at each visit. There is no trail and no tracking in the background.
settings.retentionInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 90.
settings.privacy: Positions can only be read by users who may track visits and are never shown in the audit log.
settings.creditHelp: Credit sales are never refused on upload. Flagged ones wait in the credit review.
settings.flagOffline: Flag credit decided offline for review
settings.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them.
